mapper.select: select locker_id, school_id, locker_number, status, last_used_at from lockers where school_id = #{schoolId} and status = '0' order by locker_number limit 1 for update;

select l.school_id as schoolId, s.school_name as schoolName, count(*) as totalCount, sum(case when l.status = #{freeStatus} then 1 else 0 end) as freeCount, sum(case when l.status = #{useStatus} then 1 else 0 end) as usedCount, sum(case when l.status = #{faultStatus} then 1 else 0 end) as faultCount from lockers l left join schools s on l.school_id = s.school_id group by l.school_id, s.school_name;
